svg.title: Model detail with eight navigable rows
svg.desc: Conceptual 80 by 24 dark terminal frame. The model's Default thinking is distinct from role preset thinking; arrows reach six scalar fields, image support, and Save model edits.

g.text: Provider Settings / Configure models / Model detail
Default thinking applies to direct model selection.
Role thinking is selected later under Default presets.
↑/↓ Navigate Enter Edit/save Space Toggle Esc Models
